retrievalProfile.description: A painterly illustration of figures in vintage suits set within a white-bordered frame against a dark background, featuring high-contrast serif and blackletter typography.
triggerTerms: painterly figures in suits with black border

recipe.visualDefinition: A central painterly illustration of three men in early 20th-century formal attire, rendered with visible brushstrokes and warm ochre tones, encased in a thin white frame and a thick black outer border.
coreVisualRelationships: Central illustration framed by a white rectangle
Thick black outer border containing all elements
Typography placed in a white block at the top center
Secondary text box at the bottom left corner
coreInvariants: The central illustration must maintain a painterly, non-photographic texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-length figures positioned centrally, scaled to occupy 70% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a grey suit facing away from the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top display text, down through the figures' poses, to the tracklist box at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black border creates a sense of containment and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the outer border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and mustard yellow for the illustration background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the secondary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black border and the bright yellow-orange central field.

letterConstructionRules: Top line uses a high-contrast serif with exaggerated swashes on the 'M' and 'T'.
Second line uses a stylized blackletter/gothic script with sharp terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Swash extensions on capital letters in the top line.
Diamond-shaped counters in the blackletter script.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif paired with decorative blackletter for a historical, eclectic feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blackletter aesthetic of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly illustration of three men in Edwardian suits (grey and brown) against a textured ochre background. Surround the image with a thin white frame and a thick black outer border. Leave a white rectangular space at the top center and a small white box at the bottom left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast serif text with swashes in black to the top white block. Below it, add blackletter text in deep red. In the bottom left box, add small sans-serif metadata in two columns.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border solid black?
Is the illustration painterly rather than photographic?
Is the subtitle in a red blackletter font?
Is there a white frame separating the art from the black border?

avoid: Clean vector lines in the illustration

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is legible against the white block.
Ensure the figures appear integrated into the ochre background.
Verify the black border is uniform and thick.
Confirm the swash serifs are present on the top line.
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly Illustration + Ochre Background + White Frame + Black Border + Serif/Blackletter Typography
